release_notes: Built from merged PR https://github.com/mwongj/VOD2MLIB/pull/2. Optimizes M3U-removal checks with fresh targeted lookups for every managed account/provider source across the complete Dispatcharr catalogue. Uses composite source indices in groups of at most 900 keys; does not scan/load unrelated movie, episode or show sources. Keeps account-specific show membership for episodes and checks all tracked sources independently of account activity, categories and generation batches. All queries must complete; invalid source identities, query failures and failed provider refreshes disable M3U deletion. New sources adopted during full metadata discovery are checked, and successful provider refreshes trigger fresh lookups. No cross-run source presence cache or TTL. Existing incremental generation, ownership/NFO protection, schema-3 path normalization, deadlines/cancellation and discovery controls remain unchanged. Live parity: identical presence and absence decisions for all 16,127 managed sources against the 627,666-source complete census; phase reduced from 7.04s to 0.22s. Adds requested/found source and lookup-query telemetry. Validation: 325 plugin tests passed with four Windows skips; publisher/package checks passed. TV provider refresh latency remains separate.
